scope: G16 read-only scored-run source provenance; G17-G20 out of scope
changes: The persisted-run verifier now reads tenant-scoped knowledge_search and vectorless_read tool calls from the same agent_run.
Each reviewer-entered citation must match a saved source hash, unit, optional block/version, and excerpt in a referenced tool output.
Spreadsheet row citations must locate the excerpt on a cell line with the same row number; a neighboring row cannot be substituted.
The matched source tool call ID must be included in that run's receipt ID list, and output/journal identity must match the task owner and run.

verification.tests: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/lib/knowledge/evaluation/ma24-citation-evidence.test.ts src/lib/knowledge/evaluation/ma24-persisted-run-binding.test.ts src/lib/knowledge/evaluation/ma24-independent-comparison.test.ts: 3 files, 25 tests passed
verification.lint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js on the two citation/persisted-run implementation and test files: passed
negativeCases: Citation without a saved source read is rejected
Wrong spreadsheet row or excerpt is rejected
Other-account, altered-input or mismatched output-call ID is rejected
Correct v3 search and vectorless original-read source coordinates are accepted

limitations: This checks source provenance for reviewer-entered coordinates; it does not parse or prove that the final user-visible answer actually cited those coordinates.
Source outputs are saved task journals, not an independently frozen corpus or a current ACL recheck at scoring time.
Only knowledge_search and vectorless_read provide supported precise source outputs here; other tools still need separate original-evidence verification.
No frozen Gold or real dual-arm task was used; external provider receipts and final G16 quality are unverified.
